name: Magic Academy · English
description: Combine words, objects, and costs. The small magic you name yourself will change a sealed space.

intro.hook: Combine a word, an object and a price, then name your small spell — and it will change this sealed room.
loop: Collect word fragments and objects; combine them on the spell chart
Preview the price, name the spell, then cast it
Talk with your senior and the librarian about what the spell means

characters.line: An upperclassman who asks how words and objects connect, and never hides the price
A librarian who remembers every book ever lent and returned

intro.unfinished: In development: one room and one short lesson; three endings are in, but their pictures are still placeholders.

author: Mingyue

characters.name: Seraphina
characters.description: A senior at the academy who keeps asking how words and things relate. She doesn't decide answers for others, and she doesn't hide costs.

characters.name: Librarian
characters.description: A librarian who keeps track of every loan and return. Doesn't jump to conclusions about feelings no one has voiced or outcomes no one has seen.

triggers.label: Back in the night library with a cast spell
The player leaves the lesson without casting

when.intent: The player clearly decides to end tonight's lesson without casting any spell (puts the materials down and leaves). Asking about costs, revising or 'not yet' does not count.
